verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a native sync of invoices, payments, or recognition entries to a general ledger or ERP such as QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite. Recurly RevRec is documented as automating ASC 606/IFRS 15 recognition, and report exports cover invoices and revenue recognition, but exporting reports is the CSV workflow the story wants to avoid. Webhooks and APIs are developer building blocks, not a GL/ERP connector, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, invoices, payments, and recognition entries sync to my general ledger or ERP — QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite — so the close doesn't need CSV surgery
